Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in the final comparison step. While it correctly identified the birth years (Marco Ferreri: 1928, Laurent Tirard: 1967) and correctly stated that 1967 is later than 1928, it then incorrectly concluded that "Diary of a Maniac... has the director born later." This contradicts the premise of the question ("Which film has the director born later?") and the data it just presented. The Planner confused the film associated with the later-born director (Return Of The Hero) with the film associated with the earlier-born director (Diary Of A Maniac) in its final sentence.
